verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single docs line showing Azure Copilot, a first-party AI assistant, can generate Terraform configurations, which is one delegated task inside the product. Nothing documents Copilot's broader scope, where it appears in the portal or CLI, or whether it can carry out multi-step actions on resources. missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's general task-delegation scope, evidence it can execute actions on Azure resources rather than only generate config, details on in-portal or CLI integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
